title: Hansel and Gretel
moral: Home is the coziest place of all.
notes: 영어 읽어 주기 대본(docs/READ_MODE.md §3-4). text 는 한국어 줄(키), en 이 읽는 문장. reuse 는 voice_script_en.json 의 en 그대로, trim 은 같은 문장 경계에서 자른 것, new 만 새로 녹음한다. 배역·연기 지시는 read_script_el.json 의 같은 줄을 따른다.

acts.pebbles:show | pebbles:pick | pebbles:dr: 소품·연출(조약돌 줍기·떨어뜨리기, 부스러기, 산딸기, 사탕 붙이기, 열쇠, 새장 열림, 화덕 문, 모자 날아감, 오리 건너기, 문짝)

lines.text: 옛날 옛날에 숲 옆 작은 집에 헨젤과 그레텔이 살았어요.
lines.en: Once upon a time, Hansel and Gretel lived in a little house beside the forest.
segs: Once upon a time, Hansel and Gretel lived in a little house beside the forest.

lines.text: 그런데 집에는 먹을 것이 점점 떨어져, 찬장이 텅텅 비었지요.
lines.en: But the food at home was running out, and the cupboard was bare, empty as could be.
segs: But the food at home was running out, and the cupboard was bare, empty as could be.

lines.text: 어느 날 밤, 헨젤은 문틈으로 엿들었어요.
lines.en: One night, Hansel listened at the crack of the door.
segs: One night, Hansel listened at the crack of the door.

lines.text: "먹을 게 없어요. 내일 아이들을 숲에 두고 와요." 새엄마가 말했어요.
lines.en: "There's no food left. Tomorrow, let's leave the children in the forest," said the stepmother.
segs: There's no food left. Tomorrow, let's leave the children in the forest.

lines.text: "음… 아이들이 가엾은데…" 아빠는 망설였어요.
lines.en: "Hmm... the poor children..." Father hesitated.

lines.text: 헨젤은 가슴이 콩닥콩닥 뛰었어요. 그래도 꼭 참고 생각했지요.
lines.en: Hansel's heart went thump, thump, thump. But he stayed quiet and thought hard.
segs: Hansel's heart went thump, thump, thump. But he stayed quiet and thought hard.

lines.text: 헨젤은 살금살금 밖으로 나왔어요. 달빛에 조약돌이 반짝반짝!
lines.en: Hansel tiptoed outside. Pebbles twinkled in the moonlight!
segs: Hansel tiptoed outside. Pebbles twinkled in the moonlight!

lines.text: 헨젤은 하얀 조약돌을 하나, 또 하나, 주머니에 쏙쏙 넣었어요.
lines.en: Hansel picked up the white pebbles, one, and another, and tucked them into his pockets, plop, plop.
segs: Hansel picked up the white pebbles, one, and another, and tucked them into his pockets, plop, plop.

lines.text: 헨젤은 조약돌을 주머니에 가득 채웠어요. "이제 괜찮아."
lines.en: Hansel filled his pockets with pebbles. "Now we'll be fine."
segs: Hansel filled his pockets with pebbles.

lines.text: 다음 날, 아빠는 둘을 데리고 숲 깊은 곳으로 갔어요.
lines.en: The next day, Father took the two of them deep into the forest.
segs: The next day, Father took the two of them deep into the forest.

lines.text: 헨젤은 조약돌을 하나씩 살짝 떨어뜨렸어요.
lines.en: Hansel quietly dropped the pebbles one by one.
segs: Hansel quietly dropped the pebbles one by one.

lines.text: 뚜벅뚜벅, 셋은 숲속 깊이 들어갔어요. 나뭇잎이 바스락바스락 소리를 냈지요.
lines.en: Tramp, tramp, the three went deep into the forest. The leaves rustled, rustle, rustle.
segs: Tramp, tramp, the three went deep into the forest. The leaves rustled, rustle, rustle.

lines.text: 아빠는 둘을 숲에 남겨 두고 돌아갔어요.
lines.en: Father left the two of them in the forest and went back.
segs: Father left the two of them in the forest and went back.

lines.text: 밤이 되자 조약돌이 달빛에 반짝반짝 빛났어요. 둘은 조약돌을 따라 집으로 돌아왔어요.
lines.en: When night came, the pebbles twinkled in the moonlight. The two followed them all the way home.
segs: When night came, the pebbles twinkled in the moonlight. The two followed them all the way home.

lines.text: 하지만 얼마 뒤, 새엄마가 또 아이들을 숲에 두고 오자고 했어요.
lines.en: But not long after, the stepmother said again to leave the children in the forest.
segs: But not long after, the stepmother said again to leave the children in the forest.

lines.text: 이번엔 밤에 문이 잠겨서, 조약돌을 주울 수 없었어요.
lines.en: This time the door was locked at night, so Hansel could not gather pebbles.
segs: This time the door was locked at night, so Hansel could not gather pebbles.

lines.text: "얘들아, 숲에 산딸기 따러 가자!" 아빠가 말했어요.
lines.en: Children, let's go pick berries in the forest! said Papa.
segs: Children, let's go pick berries in the forest!

lines.text: 헨젤은 빵 부스러기로 길을 표시하기로 했어요.
lines.en: Hansel decided to mark the way with bread crumbs.
segs: Hansel decided to mark the way with bread crumbs.

lines.text: 숲길에서 헨젤은 빵 부스러기를 솔솔, 하나씩 떨어뜨렸어요.
lines.en: Along the forest path, Hansel sprinkled bread crumbs, one by one, sprinkle, sprinkle.
segs: Along the forest path, Hansel sprinkled bread crumbs, one by one, sprinkle, sprinkle.

lines.text: 부스러기가 콩콩, 길게 줄을 이었지요.
lines.en: The crumbs made a long, long trail behind him, dot, dot, dot.
segs: The crumbs made a long, long trail behind him, dot, dot, dot.

lines.text: 빈터에는 빨간 산딸기가 가득했어요. 둘은 냠냠 따 먹었어요.
lines.en: The clearing was full of red berries. The two of them munched away.
segs: The clearing was full of red berries. The two of them munched away.

lines.text: 아삭아삭, 새콤달콤! 손가락이 빨갛게 물들었어요.
lines.en: Crunch, crunch, sweet and sour! Their fingers turned bright red with berry juice.
segs: Crunch, crunch, sweet and sour! Their fingers turned bright red with berry juice.

lines.text: 배가 부르니 졸려서 둘은 나무 밑에서 깜빡 잠이 들었어요.
lines.en: With full tummies, they got sleepy and dozed off under a tree.
segs: With full tummies, they got sleepy and dozed off under a tree.

lines.text: 눈을 떠 보니 아빠가 보이지 않았어요. 둘은 길을 잃었어요.
lines.en: When they woke up, Papa was nowhere to be seen. They were lost.
segs: When they woke up, Papa was nowhere to be seen. They were lost.

lines.text: 그레텔은 마음이 조금 무서웠어요.
lines.en: Gretel felt a little scared.

lines.text: 깜깜한 숲에서 부엉이가 부엉부엉 울었거든요.
lines.en: An owl hooted, hoo, hoo, somewhere in the dark forest.
segs: An owl hooted, hoo, hoo, somewhere in the dark forest.

lines.text: "괜찮아, 빵 부스러기 길을 따라가자!" 헨젤이 말했어요.
lines.en: It's okay, let's follow the crumb trail! said Hansel.
segs: It's okay, let's follow the crumb trail!

lines.text: 그런데 이상해요. 빵 부스러기가 하나도 없어요!
lines.en: But how strange! There were no crumbs left at all!
segs: But how strange! There were no crumbs left at all!

lines.text: 둘은 두리번두리번, 땅바닥을 샅샅이 살폈어요.
lines.en: They looked all around, this way and that, searching every inch of the ground.
segs: They looked all around, this way and that, searching every inch of the ground.

lines.text: 작은 새가 빵 부스러기를 물고 있어요.
lines.en: A little bird has a crumb in its beak.
segs: A little bird has a crumb in its beak.

lines.text: "짹짹! 맛있어서 내가 다 먹었어!" 새가 말했어요.
lines.en: Tweet tweet! They were so yummy, I ate them all! said the bird.
segs: Tweet tweet! They were so yummy, I ate them all!

lines.text: 헨젤은 눈물이 글썽했지만 그레텔의 손을 꼭 잡고 걸었어요.
lines.en: Hansel's eyes got teary, but he held Gretel's hand tight and kept walking.
segs: Hansel's eyes got teary, but he held Gretel's hand tight and kept walking.

lines.text: 그때 달콤한 냄새가 솔솔 났어요. 앗, 과자 집이에요!
lines.en: Then a sweet smell drifted by. Oh! A candy house!
segs: Then a sweet smell drifted by. Oh! A candy house!

lines.text: 벽은 쿠키, 지붕은 사탕이에요.
lines.en: The walls are cookies and the roof is candy.
segs: The walls are cookies and the roof is candy.

lines.text: 헨젤은 쿠키 벽을 와삭, 그레텔은 사탕 지붕을 오도독 깨물었어요.
lines.en: Hansel bit into the cookie wall, crunch, and Gretel nibbled the candy roof, crackle, crackle.
segs: Hansel bit into the cookie wall, crunch, and Gretel nibbled the candy roof, crackle, crackle.

lines.text: 너무 맛있어서 둘은 배가 빵빵해졌어요.
lines.en: It was so yummy that their tummies got round and full.
segs: It was so yummy that their tummies got round and full.

lines.text: 헨젤은 지붕에 빠진 사탕을 하나씩 다시 콕콕 붙여 주었지요.
lines.en: Then Hansel stuck the missing candies back on the roof, one by one, pop, pop, pop.
segs: Then Hansel stuck the missing candies back on the roof, one by one, pop, pop, pop.

lines.text: 그때 문이 열리고 마녀 할머니가 나왔어요.
lines.en: Then the door opened, and a witch granny came out.
segs: Then the door opened, and a witch granny came out.

lines.text: "내 과자 집을 누가 먹었니!" 마녀가 투덜거렸어요.
lines.en: Who ate my candy house? grumbled the witch.

lines.text: 마녀는 과자를 아끼는 심술쟁이 할머니였어요.
lines.en: The witch was a grumpy granny who kept all her sweets to herself.
segs: The witch was a grumpy granny who kept all her sweets to herself.

lines.text: "내 사탕! 내 쿠키! 으으, 아까워라!" 마녀는 발을 쿵쿵 굴렀어요.
lines.en: "My candy! My cookies! Oh, what a waste!" The witch stamped her feet, stomp, stomp.
segs: My candy! My cookies! Oh, what a waste!
The witch stamped her feet, stomp, stomp.

lines.text: 마녀는 헨젤을 새장에 쏙 넣어 버렸어요. "과자 값을 낼 때까지 여기 있어!"
lines.en: The witch popped Hansel into a cage. Stay there until you pay for the candy!
segs: The witch popped Hansel into a cage.
Stay there until you pay for the candy!

lines.text: 그레텔은 마녀가 낮잠을 자는 사이에 열쇠 세 개를 가져왔어요.
lines.en: While the witch napped, Gretel fetched three keys.
segs: While the witch napped, Gretel fetched three keys.

lines.text: 동그라미, 세모, 별 모양. 그레텔은 자물쇠 구멍을 요리조리 살펴보았어요.
lines.en: A circle, a triangle, and a star. Gretel peered at the keyhole this way and that.
segs: A circle, a triangle, and a star. Gretel peered at the keyhole this way and that.

lines.text: "별 모양이야!" 그레텔은 별 열쇠를 살며시 꽂았어요.
lines.en: "It is the star!" Gretel gently slid the star key into the lock.
segs: Gretel gently slid the star key into the lock.

lines.text: 찰칵! 새장이 열렸어요. 헨젤이 폴짝 뛰어나왔어요!
lines.en: Click! The cage opened. Hansel hopped out!
segs: Click! The cage opened. Hansel hopped out!

lines.text: "고마워, 그레텔!" 헨젤이 말했어요.
lines.en: Thank you, Gretel! said Hansel.

lines.text: 그때 마녀가 일어나 쿵쿵 걸어왔어요. 눈이 나빠서 더듬더듬 찾았어요.
lines.en: Then the witch woke up and stomped over. She could not see well, so she felt around for them.
segs: Then the witch woke up and stomped over. She could not see well, so she felt around for them.

lines.text: 그레텔은 꾀가 났어요. "마녀님, 화덕 안에 반짝이는 게 있어요!"
lines.en: Gretel had a clever idea. Witch, there is something sparkly in the oven!
segs: Witch, there is something sparkly in the oven!

lines.text: 마녀가 화덕 안을 기웃기웃 들여다보자, 그레텔이 화덕 문을 힘껏 밀었어요.
lines.en: When the witch leaned in to peek inside the oven, Gretel gave the oven door a mighty push.
segs: When the witch leaned in to peek inside the oven, Gretel gave the oven door a mighty push.

lines.text: 쾅! 마녀는 깜짝 놀라 모자가 휙 날아갔어요.
lines.en: Bang! The witch jumped in fright, and her hat flew off.
segs: Bang! The witch jumped in fright, and her hat flew off.

lines.text: 마녀는 빗자루를 타고 굴뚝으로 휘리릭 날아갔어요. "다시는 안 올게~!"
lines.en: The witch hopped on her broom and whooshed up the chimney. I won't come back again!
segs: The witch hopped on her broom and whooshed up the chimney.

lines.text: "휴, 이제 집으로 가자!" 헨젤이 그레텔의 손을 잡았어요.
lines.en: "Phew! Now let us go home!" Hansel took Gretel's hand.
segs: Phew! Now let us go home!

lines.text: 집으로 가는 길에 넓은 강이 나왔어요. 다리가 없어요!
lines.en: On the way home, they came to a wide river. There was no bridge!
segs: On the way home, they came to a wide river. There was no bridge!

lines.text: 강물이 콸콸, 세차게 흘렀어요.
lines.en: The river rushed and roared, splash, splash, swift and strong.
segs: The river rushed and roared, splash, splash, swift and strong.

lines.text: 그때 흰 오리가 헤엄쳐 왔어요.
lines.en: Then a white duck came swimming.
segs: Then a white duck came swimming.

lines.text: "꽥꽥! 내 등에 타!" 오리가 말했어요.
lines.en: Quack quack! Hop on my back! said the duck.
segs: Quack quack! Hop on my back!

lines.text: 둘은 오리 등에 폴짝 올라탔어요. 오리는 둥실둥실 강을 건넜지요.
lines.en: The two hopped onto the duck's back. The duck bobbed and paddled, bob, bob, across the river.
segs: The two hopped onto the duck's back. The duck bobbed and paddled, bob, bob, across the river.

lines.text: 오리가 둘을 태우고 강을 건너 주었어요. "고마워, 오리야!"
lines.en: The duck carried them across the river. Thank you, Duck!
segs: The duck carried them across the river.

lines.text: 그레텔은 오리의 보드라운 깃털을 살살 쓰다듬어 주었어요.
lines.en: Gretel gently stroked the duck's soft, fluffy feathers.
segs: Gretel gently stroked the duck's soft, fluffy feathers.

lines.text: 저 멀리 집이 보여요. 아빠가 숲에서 둘을 애타게 찾고 있었어요.
lines.en: They could see their house far away. Papa had been searching the forest for them, so worried.
segs: They could see their house far away. Papa had been searching the forest for them, so worried.

lines.text: "헨젤! 그레텔!" 아빠가 달려왔어요.
lines.en: Hansel! Gretel! Papa came running.

lines.text: 아빠는 두 아이를 번쩍 안아 올려 빙글빙글 돌았어요.
lines.en: Papa scooped up both children and spun them round and round.
segs: Papa scooped up both children and spun them round and round.

lines.text: "찾았다! 보고 싶었어!" 아빠가 말했어요.
lines.en: Found you! I missed you so much! said Papa.
segs: Found you! I missed you so much!

lines.text: 헨젤과 그레텔은 마음이 따뜻하고 행복했어요.
lines.from: 헨젤과 그레텔은 마음이 따뜻하고 행복했어요. 여러분은 기분이 어때요? 헨젤을 톡! 만세!
lines.en: Hansel and Gretel felt warm and happy.
segs: Hansel and Gretel felt warm and happy.

lines.text: 그날 밤, 둘은 포근한 이불 속에서 새근새근 잠이 들었답니다.
lines.en: That night, the two of them snuggled under their cozy blankets and fell fast asleep, zzz.
segs: That night, the two of them snuggled under their cozy blankets and fell fast asleep, zzz.

lines.text: 우리 집이 제일 포근해요. 헨젤과 그레텔 이야기는 이렇게 끝났어요.
lines.en: Home is the coziest place. That is how the story of Hansel and Gretel ended.
segs: Home is the coziest place. That is how the story of Hansel and Gretel ended.
